requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Morning, the mist outside the mountain gate hadn't dissipated yet."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yunzhou, you've finally returned. Have you brought enough spirit stones?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Brought three bags, all the best from the back mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The barrier cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Word finished before it was spoken, Wan Yi Qi Jing from below rushed up."}, {"id": 1, "text": "He gasped and said, 'There was a young woman lying on the side of the road at the foot of the mountain.'"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Quickly lift it up. If Yuè Shuǐ, go and fetch the healing medicine pills."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wanwei Jing carried the unconscious woman into the main hall, the iron badge on his waist inscribed with: Qius霜."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The injury isn't serious, just consume a Return Spirit Pill."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Ms. Zeng and Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier side; we are here with Mr. Wan Si."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Okay. Miss Chou is awake, immediately call me."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wan Yi Jing scratched his head and turned to run towards the foot of the mountain."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Jiě Xuán stood at the entrance of the hall, his sword still sheathed, but the light flickered for a moment."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Master Qin, how are you? I have come at the order of the pavilion master to collect three hundred spirit stones."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Three成? Lingshi is the zongmen's hard-earned savings, when did it come time for outsiders to take it?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "The barrier has already broken, Lingshi is not safe in your hands. In three days, I will return."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "解玄冷笑一声,转身便走,头也不回."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "He said three days is three days, and never breaks his word."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Qin Elder stroked his beard, looking at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the table."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Elder, let me guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Luo Chu watching over her, I'm free to leave."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, nodded, took out a jade token from his sleeve."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is the Eye Array Order. Guarding it is equivalent to guarding your path."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "乐川将药囊塞进云舟怀里，又低声叮嘱了几句。"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "At the mountain entrance, Wan Yi Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣)." }, {"id": 1, "text": "Thank you, Master Wan Yi Jing. Tell Miss Chou that I thank her for waking up."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Dan Yunzhou nodded, tucking the array command close to his body."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the palace, Chu Shuang slowly opened her eyes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Wake up. You've been unconscious for a whole day, don't move around randomly ▼"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "仇霜 struggled to sit up and looked out at the torn curtain of sky."},{"id": 1, "text": "Unnoticed, a seal from Gu Xuan was stamped on the note in her sleeve."}]}

translations.18: He said three days is three days, and never breaks his word.
translations.19: Qin Elder stroked his beard, looking at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the table.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you've finally returned. Have you brought enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Luo Chu watching over her, I'm free to leave.
translations.21: Finally, nodded, took out a jade token from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the Eye Array Order. Guarding it is equivalent to guarding your path.
translations.23: 乐川将药囊塞进云舟怀里，又低声叮嘱了几句。
translations.24: At the mountain entrance, Wan Yi Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣).
translations.25: Thank you, Master Wan Yi Jing. Tell Miss Chou that I thank her for waking up.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded, tucking the array command close to his body.
translations.27: In the palace, Chu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
